mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investments, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within a month indicates a weakening labor market, which leads to reduced consumer spending and corporate earnings, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (proxied by RSAFS) over three consecutive months signals a weakening demand, which reduces corporate revenues and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where RSAFS declined for three consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in industrial production (proxied by INDPRO) by more than 1% in a month signals a strengthening supply side, which boosts corporate productivity and earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where INDPRO increased by more than 1% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 4% and CPI (CPIAUCSL) increases by more than 0.5% in a month, it indicates an inflationary environment with tight monetary policy, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increases > 0.5% in 1 month
regime_hint: inflationary environment with tight monetary policy
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where FEDFUNDS > 4% and CPIAUCSL increased by more than 0.5% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.3% in a month and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000, it signals a strengthening labor market, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE decreases > 0.3% and PAYEMS increases > 200,000 in 1 month
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where UNRATE decreased by more than 0.3% and PAYEMS increased by more than 200,000 within a month.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 10% in a month signals a weakening demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader economic slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where HOUST decreased by more than 10% within a month.

mechanism_narrative: When GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% in a quarter and industrial production (INDPRO) increases by more than 1% in the same period, it signals a robust economic expansion, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 2% and INDPRO increases > 1% in 1 quarter
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where GDPC1 increased by more than 2% and INDPRO increased by more than 1% in the same quarter.
